LanguageData.BOR_OrientisChoiceText: You are at the precipice of madness. I give you a choice - go down the dark path and lose yourself to the Dark Archotech's machinations, or turn away and embrace the light.
LanguageData.BOR_OrientisLightBegins: The light descends on the colony.
LanguageData.BOR_OrientisDoneText: The tenebral is gone from the colony. Those who were stripped of it now walk as Orientis, and can manifest Orientis buildings with their new ability. The dark altars have fallen, and every tenebral and Umbral building stands dead.

LanguageData.BOR_MeditationNoCache: no meditation cache with room nearby
LanguageData.BOR_ShieldDesc: A shield that covers 25 tiles in every direction and runs on stored meditation power. It stops incoming projectiles, mortar fire and orbital bombardments, and burns tenebral and Umbral pawns inside: -35% consciousness at once, and 5% more every hour.\n\nAn Orientis pawn has to walk to the pod to raise it. It falls when the map runs out of meditation power.
